verdict.rationale: Bevy is distributed exclusively as a Rust crate via crates.io/cargo (bevy-docs-21, bevy-probe-rt-1), not as an npm/JS package; its 'Web' platform support (bevy-docs-6) means compiling to WASM as a game binary, not shipping a tree-shakeable JS library a web developer imports and bundles. No evidence shows npm registry presence, ES-module packaging, or tree-shaking support.
